notes: Medium-bucket sysadmin task (total 13). A provisioning script must repair four stacked service faults on one host without systemd: name resolution + hostname (broken /etc/hosts, fragmented nsswitch, unqualified hostname), bring up three JVM daemon roles and a live RPC health report reflected in /app/status.json, and reconfigure postfix so the announcement list is delivered to local mailboxes instead of being relayed away. Difficulty comes from the dependency ordering (DNS and daemon liveness gate a healthy report), subtle root-cause of the hijacked relayhost, the need for persistent file-based fixes (not volatile shell state), idempotence under repeated verifier execution, and the hidden cases that re-run the deliverable against different site descriptors (different ports/hostnames/capacity) plus a malformed descriptor that must abort without side effects. The agent's own script must genuinely generalize across sites and leave durable configuration, matching the medium floors of the DNS, persistence, and list-mail competencies.
